title: DSA reasoning practice rubric
disclaimer: An Engineering Foundry self-review aid—not an employer scoring system or hiring prediction.

dimensions.label: Clarification
dimensions.description: Clarifies inputs, outputs, constraints, and edge cases before committing.

dimensions.label: Approach
dimensions.description: Builds a coherent strategy and explains why it fits.

dimensions.label: Correctness
dimensions.description: Maintains the stated invariant and handles important cases.

dimensions.label: Complexity reasoning
dimensions.description: Explains time and space costs accurately.

dimensions.label: Implementation discipline
dimensions.description: Writes organized code with deliberate state and naming.

dimensions.label: Testing
dimensions.description: Tests normal, edge, and failure-prone cases.

dimensions.label: Communication
dimensions.description: Makes reasoning visible and responds constructively to prompts.

title: System Design reasoning practice rubric
disclaimer: An Engineering Foundry self-review aid—not an employer scoring system or hiring prediction.

dimensions.label: Requirement clarification
dimensions.description: Defines scope, users, scale assumptions, and priorities.

dimensions.label: Decomposition
dimensions.description: Separates responsibilities and traces core request paths.

dimensions.label: Scalability
dimensions.description: Finds likely bottlenecks and scales the relevant components.

dimensions.label: Data and storage reasoning
dimensions.description: Chooses models and storage based on access and consistency needs.

dimensions.label: Reliability
dimensions.description: Addresses failures, recovery, idempotency, and observability.

dimensions.label: Tradeoffs
dimensions.description: Makes alternatives and consequences explicit.

dimensions.label: Communication
dimensions.description: Keeps the design legible and responds to changing constraints.

title: Low-Level Design reasoning practice rubric
disclaimer: An Engineering Foundry self-review aid—not an employer scoring system or hiring prediction.

dimensions.label: Scope and use cases
dimensions.description: Clarifies actors, the primary behavior, constraints, and deliberate non-goals.

dimensions.label: Domain modeling
dimensions.description: Chooses concepts with meaningful identity, state, or behavior without modeling every noun.

dimensions.label: Responsibilities
dimensions.description: Gives decisions, state changes, and side effects clear owners.

dimensions.label: Interfaces and contracts
dimensions.description: Defines operations, results, and collaboration boundaries that preserve encapsulation.

dimensions.label: State and invariants
dimensions.description: Makes lifecycle, legal transitions, and failure behavior explicit.

dimensions.label: Evolution and testability
dimensions.description: Handles a follow-up change and identifies useful seams for deterministic tests.

dimensions.label: Tradeoffs
dimensions.description: Explains alternatives and adds patterns only when concrete variation earns them.

dimensions.label: Communication
dimensions.description: Keeps the model legible and validates it by walking representative behavior.

title: ML System Design reasoning practice rubric
disclaimer: An Engineering Foundry self-review aid—not an employer scoring system or hiring prediction.

dimensions.label: Product framing
dimensions.description: Defines the decision, user value, actions, and constraints.

dimensions.label: Metric selection
dimensions.description: Connects offline, online, and guardrail metrics to the goal.

dimensions.label: Data and labels
dimensions.description: Addresses sources, labels, leakage, bias, and freshness.

dimensions.label: Baseline and model reasoning
dimensions.description: Starts with a defensible baseline and justifies complexity.

dimensions.label: Serving
dimensions.description: Explains online boundaries, latency, versioning, and fallback.

dimensions.label: Monitoring
dimensions.description: Covers data, model, product, and feedback-loop health.

dimensions.label: Tradeoffs
dimensions.description: Makes quality, latency, safety, and cost choices visible.

dimensions.label: Communication
dimensions.description: Keeps the ML system connected to the product decision.

title: Behavioral answer practice rubric
disclaimer: An Engineering Foundry self-review aid—not an employer scoring system or hiring prediction.

dimensions.label: Relevance
dimensions.description: Chooses a truthful example that directly answers the prompt.

dimensions.label: Context
dimensions.description: Provides enough situation and stakes without crowding out action.

dimensions.label: Personal ownership
dimensions.description: Separates personal responsibility from the team's work.

dimensions.label: Decisions and actions
dimensions.description: Explains the choices, alternatives, and concrete steps taken.

dimensions.label: Outcome
dimensions.description: Gives a credible result and appropriate evidence.

dimensions.label: Reflection
dimensions.description: Shows learning and what changed afterward.

dimensions.label: Communication
dimensions.description: Answers clearly, specifically, and with fair attribution.
